The '''Aitken Lectureship''' is awarded by the [[New Zealand Mathematical Society]] to a research mathematician from New Zealand. The lectureship is named for New Zealand professor [[Alexander Aitken]], who was a highly distinguished mathematician who spent most of his career at the [[University of Edinburgh]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Alexander Craig Aitken |url=https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Aitken/#:~:text=He%20was%20appointed%20to%20Edinburgh,Fellow%20of%20the%20Royal%20Society.}}</ref> The lectureship was funded in 2009 by the [[London Mathematical Society]] and the New Zealand Mathematical Society, and is normally awarded every two years, alternating with the [[Forder Lectureship]]. Recipients of the lectureship will give a several-week lecturing tour of UK universities and a lecture at the annual meeting of the London society.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/events/lectures/forder-and-aitken-lectureship|title=LMS-NZMS Forder and Aitken Lectureships {{!}} London Mathematical Society|website=www.lms.ac.uk|language=en|access-date=2018-11-13}}</ref>

== Recipients ==
The recipients of the Aitken Lectureship are:<ref name=":1"/>

* 2011: Geoff Whittle<ref>{{Cite web |title=LMS Aitken Lectures |url=https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/scott/Pages/aitkenoct2011.htm |access-date=2024-04-28 |website=people.maths.ox.ac.uk}}</ref>
* 2013: Robert Mclachlan<ref>{{Cite web |title=Robert I McLachlan (Massey University): Successes and prospects of geometric numerical integration. |url=https://www.imperial.ac.uk/events/107744/robert-i-mclachlan-massey-university-successes-and-prospects-of-geometric-numerical-integration/ |access-date=2024-04-28 |website=Imperial College London |language=en-GB}}</ref>
* 2015: Steven Galbraith<ref>{{Cite web |title=Aitken Mathematical Lectureship for St Cross Alumnus |url=https://stx.web.ox.ac.uk/article/aitken-mathematical-lectureship-for-st-cross-alumnus |access-date=2024-04-28 |website=stx.web.ox.ac.uk |language=en}}</ref>
* 2017: [[Hinke Osinga]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=talks.cam : AITKEN PUBLIC LECTURE - Shaken but not stirred: using mathematics in earthquakes |url=https://talks.cam.ac.uk/talk/index/72275 |access-date=2024-04-28 |website=talks.cam.ac.uk}}</ref>
* 2019: Bakh Khoussainov<ref>{{Cite web |title=Academy of Europe: Khoussainov Bakhodyr |url=https://www.ae-info.org/ae/Member/Khoussainov_Bakhodyr |access-date=2024-04-28 |website=www.ae-info.org}}</ref>
* 2022: [[Lisa Orloff Clark]]<ref>{{Cite web |title=LMS Aitken Lecture Tour 2022: Aitken Lecture at QUB {{!}} London Mathematical Society |url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/events/Aitken2022QUB |access-date=2024-04-28 |website=www.lms.ac.uk}}</ref>
